_how_to_edit: Every bill, rule and filing we've worked on, newest activity first. To add one, copy a block, paste it into the list and change the words. status is one of: open (comments or votes open now), drafting, ready (written, needs a sponsor), moving (in the legislature or a rulemaking), adopted, law, closed. Every date in dates is checked daily by Ash HQ: next_check is the day we promise to look at this entry again, and Mav gets an alert if that day passes without an update.

items.title: Colorado's AI decision and chatbot rules
items.summary: The rules that decide how Colorado's new right works: when a computer helped turn you down for housing, a job, credit, care or school, you're owed a notice, the names of the data sources, and a real human review.
items.our_role: We filed a 9-page comment on October 2. Most of our asks were adopted on November 19. The biggest one wasn't: the definition of a trivial factor. Next we're asking the legislature's rule reviewers to look at it, and working on a fix for 2027.

items.title: Colorado Everyday Stability Act (CESA)
items.summary: The seven pillars of life stability for every Coloradan: health, income, family, housing, food, opportunity, and protection from disruption, funded mainly through TABOR-compliant enterprise fees, with no income tax increase.
items.our_role: We wrote it. It's complete and ready for a lawmaker to carry it.

items.title: Fair Work and Mutual Responsibility Act (FWMRA)
items.summary: A just-cause employment bill and companion to CESA: honest grounds and fair process for workers, capped and predictable costs for employers. One fair standard for every employer.
items.our_role: We wrote it. Version 6.2 is complete and ready for a lawmaker to carry it.

items.title: United States Rapid Action and Preparedness Act (US-RAPA)
items.summary: A democracy-protection framework focused on citizen empowerment, election security, and putting real power back in people's hands at the national level.
items.our_role: We're writing it, and looking for a federal champion.
